purpose: Surface orientation and flipping for Spiny, Buzzy Beetle and Spike Top.
dependencies: Independent standalone; later combined surface path must coexist with #14, #21, #23 and #24.

title: Fix fire bar rendering, length, and rotation
purpose: Fire Bar variable lengths, unsigned rotation data and guarded sprite drawing.
dependencies: Independent; overlaps only the shared drawing method.

title: Fix Wiggler rendering across all game styles

dependencies: Independent; precede #23 to preserve approved Shoe/Stiletto aspect ratio and wing behavior.

dependencies: Independent free-standing wings. Final pipe/wing behavior requires #21, custom Shoes from #22, and separate integration-only pivot/artwork/calibration work.

purpose: Playing-card symbols on linked normal/P/key doors with safe image completion.
dependencies: Independent; union symbol images with other optional assets; preserve its safe completion behavior.

title: Fix UTF-16BE decoding of Unicode course names
purpose: Decode big-endian UTF-16 course names without dropping non-ASCII code units or surrogate pairs.
dependencies: Independent; first to separate parser-only work.
